reconcile.note: Adam Clarke suggests Jabin was a dynastic title and that Canaanites rebuilt Hazor, making Judges' king a later ruler distinct from the one Joshua defeated.

sides.snippet: when Jabin king of Hazor heard of it
sides.verseText: It happened, when Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

sides.snippet: Yahweh sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor
sides.verseText: Yahweh sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
